text:
Vera N: Heads-up — a few reviewers asked to swap calibration slots because of launch sprints. Thinking of running a short "swap marketplace" window so people can trade slots without us manually editing calendars. Thoughts?
Ben S: Love the idea. We should enforce a hard swap cutoff (48h before calibration) and require manager approval for swaps that change reviewer team coverage.
Ivy H: Agree. Also suggest a lightweight audit column so People Ops can see who swapped with whom and why. Makes reconciliation easier.
Vera N: Proposal: open swap marketplace for 24 hours only. Rules: (1) swaps allowed up to 48h before calibration start, (2) both reviewers need manager ok in the swap form, (3) swaps involving leads require People Ops sign-off. We'll auto-update calendar after approvals.
Marcus P: One caveat — if a swap causes reviewer load imbalance (someone goes over cap), block the swap and prompt them to accept overflow or pick a different slot.
Ben S: Add a soft cap check during swap submission and show remaining capacity. Good guardrail.
Ivy H: Also add an opt-in help: if you can't find a swap, reviewers can mark "need swap" and People Ops will try to find a volunteer backup.
Juno (HR Bot): I can build the marketplace form and enforce manager approvals. I will also add an audit log CSV and calendar sync. Parameters I need: swap_window_hours=24, swap_cutoff_hours=48, default_cap=5. Confirm and I will deploy the form link.
Vera N: Confirmed. Default_cap=5, swap_window_hours=24, swap_cutoff_hours=48. People Ops will publish a 1-line FAQ and post the form link. Draft announcement below — posting in 30 minutes if no objections:

```
Quick update: swap marketplace for calibration slots (24h window)
- Open now for 24 hours. Submit a swap request here: https://redwoodhq/reviews/swap-marketplace
- Rules: swaps allowed until 48h before calibration, both managers must approve, swaps that put someone over cap will be blocked.
- If you cannot find a match, mark "need swap" in the sheet and People Ops will try to place you in the volunteer pool.
- People Ops will auto-update calendars and publish an audit CSV for transparency.
If you have questions, reply here or DM @Vera N.
```
Ben S: No objections from eng. Please ensure timezones are clear in the form (PT vs UTC).
Ivy H: Can we add a short checkbox for "swap due to high-priority launch" so we can triage swaps that should be expedited?
Vera N: Yes — adding "swap priority" field with options: normal / launch-critical / personal-emergency. People Ops to expedite launch-critical with 2-hour SLA.
Marcus P: LGTM. Thanks for making this less manual.
Juno (HR Bot): Marketplace form deployed and calendar sync enabled. Swap window opens now and will close in 24 hours. Audit CSV located at https://redwoodhq/reviews/audit/swap-2287654321.csv.
